sources.source:
# a retained DSL source read: authored capability sources returned byte-exact with digests
capability read-capability-dsl-source
intent: Read the DSL authoring sources retained at capability authoring time, byte-exact with digests and authoring references
outcome: The retained sources READ; an invalid request refuses
input contract read-capability-dsl-source-request.v1 { "type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"capabilityId":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":200}} }
output contract read-capability-dsl-source-result.v1 { "type":"object","required":["contractId","status"],"properties":{"contractId":{"const":"capability-dsl-sources.v1"},"status":{"const":"READ"}} }
cli display outcome as json
scenario read-capability-dsl-source root terminal
given: capabilities authored from DSL exist in the estate with retained sources
when: the retained sources are read over rows
then: exact source bytes, digests and authoring references return
operation read-capability-dsl-source.read kind invoke-port port capability-dsl-source-read
bind capability-dsl-source-read
platform: sda-embodiment-plan-port.v1
provider: sda-declared-read-graph-provider.v1
statement: EXEC analysis.read_capability_dsl_source @input=@input,@estate_model_pk=@estate_model_pk;
result: value
